title: Perry Bradford, Mamie Smith and Bessie Smith
summary: Whaley confirms Perry Bradford discovered Mamie Smith, and recalls Bessie Smith at Carney's Inn.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Bessie, Mamie, Ma Rainey: the classic blues queens

blocks.x: We're just sort of skipping around now, but I'm just doing this to keep the conversation going with you. Now, what about Perry Bradford? Did you know Perry?
Perry Bradford. I'm going to tell you, Perry Bradford was one of the originals. He discovered Mamie Smith, he had Mamie Smith.
He said that, he told me that. I'm glad to hear you verify that.

Yeah, he had Mamie Smith and then Bessie Smith come on, see. And he couldn't use Bessie Smith, but he'd give her a dollar -- $100, I mean, for -- Bessie was an original, she was an original blues singer.
Bessie, she was up there at Carney's Inn. And she'd get in a high and start crying, and say, Tom, give me ten dollars, I want to buy some --
What, did Bessie Smith say that to you?
